messages:
marco: quick sync on v2 rollout — need final owners for SDK header negotiation, slice routing, and telemetry. plan is to flip a very small slice (<=5%) by Fri EOD if no blockers. call out any blocked PRs or infra constraints. cc @liz @sam @elaine :eyes:

liz: I can own SDK header negotiation. plan: make x-redwood-client opt-in, add header parsing fallback in SDK, and ship a minor release. PR opened: #712, still needs review from eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

sam: routing team will own slice routing rules. need eng-infra to add the proxy route and a feature-flag gate. cc @mike for proxy config and fallback behavior.

mike: eng-infra here — hold on proxy roll until we validate fallback policy. if the header is missing we should route to the shim variant, not 500. can someone share the smoke checklist?

liz: smoke checklist (short):
- toggle feature on 5% slice
- run SDK client with header set and without header
- assert fallback path returns v1-compatible payload
- verify latency P50/P95 within threshold
- check telemetry events include compat_fallback

fenced code for quick test:
```bash
# enable slice (example CLI)
rwctl feature enable v2_rollout --slice=5%
# smoke curl test
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'x-redwood-client: sdk-v2' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'
# without header should go to shim variant
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke no header"}'
```

dev-bot: Deploy job started for PR #712 — runner: linux-64, image: redwood/build:2026-03-16. logs: CI lint passed, unit tests running... :package:

elaine: telemetry note — we need a new event compat_fallback with fields: endpoint, client_header_present (bool), fallback_variant. I'll add an alert if fallback rate >0.5% over 1h during rollout window. also will capture baseline today for comparison.

marco: if the SDK PR blocks, fallback plan is to add a header-rewrite in proxy as temporary guard so old SDKs keep working. @liz can you draft the proxy rewrite note so eng-infra can review quickly?

liz: yes — I'll open a minimal PR that rewrites x-redwood-client -> x-redwood-client: shim when header version matches legacy. ETA ~3h. will add testing notes.

sam: also need to coordinate SDK release tag and publish time. can someone ping the release-captain for a short window?

oncall: oncall here — please include rollback play in PR description (how to flip feature off and who to page). I'll monitor the Fri smoke window and be ready for paging.

marco: action items recap: 1) liz: finalize SDK PR + proxy rewrite PR, 2) mike/eng-infra: hold proxy until rewrite is merged and review fallback, 3) sam: coordinate release tag and route gating, 4) elaine: set alert + baseline, 5) oncall: monitor and have rollback contacts. Ping this thread when PRs merge and I'll schedule a 30m smoke at T+1hr after merge. Thanks all :handshake:
